runtime.name: node
runtime.source: docs do not say; a newcomer installs the current LTS

knownFailures.signature: error: Environment variable not found: DATABASE_URL.
knownFailures.cause: The app requires DATABASE_URL at startup, but the docs never mention it.

knownFailures.signature: Error: P1001: Can't reach database server at `localhost`:`5432`
knownFailures.cause: README.md line 46 runs `npx prisma migrate deploy` without ever starting a PostgreSQL server; the error `P1001: Can't reach database server at localhost:5432` proves no database is running.
knownFailures.fix: Before running `npx prisma migrate deploy`, start a PostgreSQL instance (e.g. `docker run -d -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine`) and set DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres.
